SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT

§ 1 Parties
This agreement is made between Alpine Holding AG ("Seller") and Beta Capital GmbH ("Buyer").

§ 2 Purchase price
The purchase price is EUR 2,400,000, payable within 30 days of closing.
